headline: Air Products (APD) Stock Looks Undervalued On Cash Flow But Overvalued On Sales
summary: Air Products and Chemicals stock has gained 17.7% year to date, yet the valuation picture is mixed, with a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) intrinsic value estimate suggesting the shares sit below fair value while market multiples point the other way. The 17.7% year to date return suggests investors have already priced in a fair amount of optimism into Air Products and Chemicals.
